## Description {#details}

<p>This file implements a pass that will conditionally reset a machine function as if it was just created.</p>


<p>This is used to provide a fallback mechanism when GlobalISel fails, thus the condition for the reset to happen is that the <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/machinefunction">MachineFunction</a> has the FailedISel property.</p>
